prerequisites.windows: Windows x64 with Universal CRT (Windows 10/Server 2016 or newer)
prerequisites.visualCpp: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 compatible x64 runtime; NOT supplied by this staging script
prerequisites.universalCrt: api-ms-win-crt-* imports require the Windows Universal CRT
